Edition: Professional (Pro) Architecture: 64-bit Language: English (or as specified by purchaser) License Type: Genuine perpetual commercial license License: One license per device License Transfer: As per Microsoft licensing terms Latest available stable release at the time of supply Licensing Requirements The bidder shall provide: Genuine Microsoft Windows 11 Professional license. Original Product Key. Offline activation in accordance with Army Cyber security policy Offline Activation Requirements The supplied operating system shall support offline activation using Microsoft's official activation procedur es where internet connectivity is unavailable. No pendrive to be used. Only DVD is allowed for the software activation. The bidder shall: Install Windows 11 Professional and latest 25h2 latest patch. Complete offline activation. Demonstrate successful activation.

Provide activation confirmation. Ensure the system displays "Windows is activated" after completion. No Pen Drive To Be Used . Installation The bidder shall: Install the operating system. Configure drivers. Configure BIOS/UEFI compatibility where required. Configure TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot where supported. Install latest stable updates available at the time of installation (if internet is available before deploy ment or via approved offline update media). Configure administrator account as instructed. Compliance The supplied software shall: Be genuine Microsoft software. Be unused and newly licensed. Be eligible for future Microsoft updates.

Acceptance Criteria The software shall be accepted only after: Successful installation. Successful offline activation. Windows reports "Activated." Genuine license verification. Submission of all required documentation. Bidder Qualification The bidder shall: Be an authorized Microsoft reseller/partner or legally authorized software supplier. Provide proof of license source upon request. Certify that all supplied licenses are genuine. Pre-bid interaction and demonstration of on-site offline activation with original product is mandatory criteria for Bid eligibility. Note :- (1) Required original photographs of each items including VERSION uploaded by the vendor during partici pating in this Bid. Installation The bidder shall: Install the operating system.Configure drivers. Configure BIOS/UEFI compatibility where r equired. Configure TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot where supported. Install latest stable updates available at the time of installation ,Configure administrator account as instructed.

. 3. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 4. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support.
